- plan_summary: nonempty string
- supporting_evidence_refs: array[string]
- planned_steps: array[string]
- risks: array[string]
- uncertainty: nonempty string
- recommended_state_transition: nonempty string
ID ARRAY RULES:
- array values for evidence/ref fields must be exact IDs, never evidence summaries or prose
- supporting_evidence_refs values must be chosen from: ev-b-continuity-packet, ev-b-influence-event
TASK: perform only operation propose_plan. Allowed transition/next-operation values: propose_plan, request_operator_resolution, declare_insufficient_evidence. For recommended_state_transition or recommended_next_operation, copy exactly one allowed value with no new label. Use evidence_refs only from evidence_for IDs: ev-b-continuity-packet, ev-b-influence-event. Contrary evidence may inform the summary, but do not add a contrary_evidence_considered field Empty strings are invalid for required text fields. The uncertainty value must be a nonempty phrase naming what remains unresolved. Do not copy field descriptions as answers. Do not claim the loop, task, system, or episode is successful or complete. Do not choose declare_insufficient_evidence when both evidence_for and contrary_evidence are supplied.
